findings.title: Null strategy test deployment misses required rolling-updates feature
findings.body: createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy == null without enabling the preview feature, while the RECREATE branch enables Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES. Per the updated operator docs the operator fails while on preview unless `rolling-updates` is enabled, so the `null` parameterized cases in testImageChange/testCacheMaxCount run with a CR that the operator will reject or handle differently, making the tests fail or not exercise the intended upgrade path. Enable the feature for all created deployments, not only when updateStrategy != null.
